title: Kiye hai shimr ne do qatl
body:
Kiye Hai Shimr Ne Do Qatl Ek Khanjar Se
Lahu Hussain Ka Pocha Behen Ki Chadar Se
1) Ghareeb-E-Zahra Wahi'n Rote Rote Marr Jaata
Behen Utha Ke Na Laati Jo Laash-E-Akbar Se
2) Kisi Ne Baalo'n Se Pakda Koi Utha Ke Chala,
Sar-E-Hussain Ko Maara Kisi Ne Patthar Se
3) Use Uthaya Hai Baba Ki Laash Se Aise,
Ke Phir Sakina Nahi Soyi Shimr Ke Darr Se
4) Lab-E-Hussain(as) Pe Hass Hass Ke Marta Hai Chhadi,
Yazeed Khel Raha Tha Hussain(as) Ke Sarr Se
5) Bulaya Shaam Ke Zindan Mein Jab Sakina Ne,
Hussain Pyaase Palat Aaye Hauze Kausar Se
6) Faqat gala hi nahi shah ka kata ran me
Kate hai haath bhi zahra(sa) ke kund khanjar se
6) Behen Ka Parda Taqallum Use Bana Na Tha,
Suna Raha Tha Woh Quran Sina Ke Mimbar Se.
